theme: Last full day ashore before the charter.
greeting: Your last full day on dry land in Dubrovnik, Dan, and the calendar is clear — which is exactly the room today needs. Everything that has to happen before Saturday's 5 PM boarding wants doing now, while you still have signal and a shop within reach.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat transfers still hanging
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 hotel in Cavtat is booked, but the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, the bag hold before 3 PM check-in, and the pre-dawn Sunday checkout all need arranging from dry land — charter connectivity is poor once you're underway.

needsAttention.title: Provision before Saturday
needsAttention.detail: Cash (about 200 EUR), snacks, drinks for the week, and any gluten-free non-perishables are far easier to grab now from the downtown shops than once you're sailing; it's on today's list.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with Nautilus
needsAttention.detail: Instructor outreach is still open — pin down the exact time and place for Saturday's boarding and line up the return airport transfer for when you disembark the 19th.

flagged.title: ICGN Autumn Conference, Toronto
flagged.detail: Bookings just opened for the November governance conference — worth a glance given your network and the search.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shop promos — Booking.com, Monocle, Chairish, HBO Max, recipe digests.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Translucent Apple Tart
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in.

tasks.title: Book the Sept 20 – Oct 5 rental SUV at TPA
Lock St Pete lodging for the Sept 20-22 gap

acts.line: The morning is open — the natural window to book the Cavtat transfers and reach the Nautilus instructor while you're easily online.
Provision for the week from the downtown shops — Studenac, Tommy, Konzum — before they close on you.
Nothing on the calendar; Mike is angling for a table for two in the old town tonight.
